'''Eredenn Station''' was the main [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military base on the remote planet [[Eredenn Prime]]. The base was used for the development of the secret [[Decimator (war machine)|Decimator]] weapon. Two other Republic military facilities, the [[Facet Test Site]] and the [[Shard Test Site]], were located in the neighborhood. Eredenn Station was [[Battle of Eredenn|attacked]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="GB:CC" />
